body.statement:
For the baseline-indexed occupation-measure programs \(\mathcal B_{T,\rho}(w)\) and \(\mathcal D_{T,\rho}(w)\), determine whether there is a constant \(c>0\), independent of \(T\) and \(\rho\), for which the generalized inverse satisfies the boundary and no-overshoot relation
\[
\mathcal B_{T,\rho}(w_{T,\rho})\le T
\quad\text{and}\quad
\mathcal B_{T,\rho}(w_{T,\rho})\ge cT
\]
whenever \(w_{T,\rho}>0\), or characterize exactly the discontinuities and inactive baseline--cell pairs that prevent such saturation.  Determine separately whether strong duality holds at the relevant levels; neither strong duality nor primal or dual attainment may be assumed.  Finally, prove or disprove that the baseline-indexed occupation profiles can be jointly realized, up to universal constants, by one predictable law-independent design and one connected \(1-\delta\) honest interval with participant-welfare loss at most \(\rho\), expected width of order \(w_{T,\rho}\), and stochastic context-arrival capacities respected.
body.justification: The corrected occupation program separates the proved necessary information geometry from the unresolved common-design and interval construction.
body.gap: No cited result controls generalized-inverse jumps or jointly realizes baseline-indexed continuous-context occupation profiles under both stochastic arrival and welfare constraints.
body.consumer: Resolving this question either supplies the upper construction or exposes a new incompatibility branch in the frontier.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove or refute boundary saturation for \(\mathcal B_{T,\rho}\), determine any strong-duality conditions beyond the proved weak inequality, and couple the baseline-indexed occupation profiles into one predictable law-independent design and one connected honest interval.
obligation.obstruction: The corrected primal deliberately optimizes a different occupation profile for every baseline law. Feasibility for each baseline does not imply compatibility with a single history-dependent kernel. Moreover, monotonicity of \(w\mapsto\mathcal B_{T,\rho}(w)\) does not give right closedness or a uniform lower multiple at its generalized inverse, and the handle contains no interval endpoints or coverage calculation.
obligation.attempted: Replaced scalar quotas by exact occupation measures, embedded every actual adaptive design into the capacity and welfare constraints, proved the trajectory-KL identity for every local alternative through the existing Gaussian decomposition, and derived weak Lagrange duality. These steps certify necessity but do not supply the missing common-design coupling.
obligation.partial_result: Weak duality and the necessity of the corrected occupation relaxation are proved, including \(W_{T,\delta}\ge w_{T,\rho}\) and \(\Omega_{T,\delta}\ge2w_{T,\rho}/(1-2\delta)\).  What remains is boundary saturation, any stronger duality statement, and joint sequential realization.
